summary.intent: Execute Phase 21 (BYO IPFS Node Support) end-to-end: run all 7 plans across 4 waves, verify the implementation, and plan gap closure for issues found during UAT.
summary.outcome: All 7 plans executed and committed. Live UAT revealed 6 bugs (all fixed) and 5 gaps. Pin migration from CipherBox to external Kubo was verified working (44/44 CIDs). Four gap closure plans (21-08 through 21-11) were created for dual-pin wiring, TEE-routed connection test, PinataProvider, and benchmarks.

repo: TEE worker does not load .env files automatically — env vars must be passed inline or via the shell environment
TEE worker uses simulator mode locally (epoch 1, no real SGX required)
Migration processor used TEE_AUTH_SECRET but TeeService used TEE_WORKER_SECRET — inconsistent env var naming across the codebase
The web app upload flow does not invoke the SDK's DualPinProvider for secondary pins — the SDK client and web app are not fully wired together for BYO config
Auth store is memory-only (no localStorage/sessionStorage persistence) — cannot inject auth state for Playwright tests, must go through UI login flow
test-login API endpoint creates a deterministic keypair from email hash; calling it before email OTP for the same email causes a unique constraint violation on UQ_auth_methods_type_hash
Pinata deprecated their standard PSA endpoint (/psa returns 404); they now use a proprietary /v3/files API
Filebase's IPFS RPC endpoint (rpc.filebase.io) returns HTML error pages for /api/v0/id — non-standard behavior
DHCP on the QEMU VM bridge network reassigned the host from 192.168.133.114 to 192.168.133.12, breaking all service connections in apps/api/.env
Local Kubo nodes need explicit CORS configuration before browser-side connection tests work: Access-Control-Allow-Origin, Access-Control-Allow-Methods, Access-Control-Allow-Headers

code.finding: Used TEE_AUTH_SECRET env var but should use TEE_WORKER_SECRET to match TeeService and apps/api/.env
Decoded ECIES ciphertext as base64 but StorageTab encrypts and sends as hex (bytesToHex) — encoding mismatch caused 'bad point: got length 65' error
SSRF protection blocked 192.168.* ranges, preventing local dev testing. Also missing 'cipherbox' as a valid protocol type in parseProviderConfig
Treated 401/403/422 responses as 'endpoint not found' instead of 'authentication failed', causing misleading 'could not detect protocol' errors

Migration trigger required savedConfig to be non-null, but first-time users switching from default 'cipherbox' mode have no savedConfig (no prior IPNS record). Fixed by treating null savedConfig as implicit 'cipherbox' mode.

workflow: OTP for email login is logged to the running API console — find it by reading the pnpm dev output file from the background task rather than asking the user
Hot-reload (Nest watch mode) does not fully restart the process — port bindings persist, causing EADDRINUSE for new instances. Fixes to processors require a full kill + restart cycle
BullMQ jobs from Redis persist across API restarts — stale failed jobs get re-queued immediately on next startup before new env vars take effect
Playwright file uploads with large files (100MB total) can crash the browser page — upload files individually or in smaller batches

When triggering a new migration from the UI, the mode must actually change (prev !== current) — switching A→B→A→B won't trigger a second migration because savedConfig already equals B after the first save to B

friction: DHCP reassigned host IP mid-session (192.168.133.114 → 192.168.133.12), requiring manual .env updates and causing all service connections to fail
TEE worker not in pnpm workspace — required separate npm install and manual env var injection to start
Multiple API restart cycles due to hot-reload not fully working for processor env var changes
Playwright OTP flow was unnecessarily complicated before realizing the output file from the background pnpm dev task contains the OTP
test-login endpoint contaminated the email+OTP login path for the same user, causing a DB unique constraint violation
Pinata and Filebase both have non-standard APIs that don't work with the implemented PSA/Kubo providers, making live SaaS testing impossible
Migration UI showed stale 'failed' state from previous attempt even after a successful new migration — MigrationProgress component needs page reload to refresh
git merge conflict between docs/phase-21-context branch and main had to be resolved manually mid-session
open_items: 21-08: Wire BYO config into SDK client lifecycle so DualPinProvider is invoked during web app uploads (secondary pin not firing)
21-08: Add source unpin step after successful migration CID verification in TEE migration worker
21-09: Move connection test from browser-side (CORS-blocked) to TEE-routed endpoint — TEE decrypts provider config in-enclave, runs probe, returns result
21-10: PinataProvider using Pinata's proprietary /v3/files API (PSA endpoint deprecated and returns 404)
21-11: BYO performance baselines capture (21-byo-baselines.md) — deferred, requires real external IPFS provider infrastructure
Reverse migration (external → cipherbox) had 1/45 CID failure — likely CID version mismatch (v0 vs v1), needs investigation
Benchmark execution for dual-write mode needs testing once dual-pin upload wiring is complete (21-08)
TEE worker SSRF protection simulator bypass should be guarded by NODE_ENV=development or SIMULATE=true rather than left permanently relaxed
